title: Depth under composed coordinate restrictions
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix signs on all coordinates outside $J$. For each coordinate, choose a second restriction state: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. Compose this state assignment with the assignment that leaves coordinates in $J$ free and fixes the other coordinates to the chosen signs; the resulting restricted function on the binary cube has the same minimum decision tree depth as the function obtained by first restricting $f$ to the fixed signs outside $J$, reindexing the free coordinates by $J$, and then applying the second restriction on those coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A second restriction state assignment on all coordinates
